thread:
Ana: heads up — vendor asked if we can do a soft floor across marketplace SKUs for Q3 to qualify a private offer. thinking: a short-term usage hedge (3–6 months) rather than a straight commit. want to coordinate partner ops + SI training + joint announce timing. any blockers?
Ben: soft floor = easier for SMBs to sign. do we have current usage curves to estimate uplift?
Cheng: we can template the integration checklist for SIs — it’s mostly billing hook + usage reporting. timeline: 2 dev sprints to add the marketplace tracking tag, then SI onboarding.
Ana: rough ask from partner: guarantee $50k/mo equivalent floor across marketplace listings, but they want a top-line discount if hit 120% of floor.
Ben: propose tiered rebate: 0–100% = no rebate, 100–120% = 5% credit, >120% = 10% credit. keeps downside limited.
Elliot: need contract language for pro-rated credits and termination if partner abuses channel stacking. I’ll draft a short addendum. also need data-sharing clause for monthly reconciliation.
Sara: field note — customers hate surprise credits being clawed back. any crediting should be visible on invoice and support scripts updated. want a single FAQ we can share with CSMs.
Jamal: ops constraints: marketplace private offers can be surfaced but invoicing credits are manual today. if we automate, it’s a 3–4 week effort. otherwise we’ll need an ops playbook for manual reconciliations.
Ana: tradeoff: faster announce with manual ops vs delay for automation. partner insists on announce aligned with SI launch week of Aug 9.
Cheng: timeline check — if we start tagging next week, SI tech training can be week 3, field enablement week 4, ops runbook ready by week 5. automation would push launch ~6 weeks out.
Ben: partner marketing wants a co-branded landing page + joint webinar. can we commit to webinar in week 2 of announcement window?
Sara: webinar content needs customer-case + migration checklist. I can draft a short one-pager for the CSMs by EOW.
Elliot: legal to produce the addendum draft by Tue; include dispute resolution cadence: 30-day reconciliation, then nettable credits on next invoice.
Jamal: ops will do manual reconciliation for first two cycles if we get a sign-off now. we’ll need partner contact, monthly usage CSV, and a named finance reviewer.
Ana: action items: 1) Elliot — addendum draft (Tue). 2) Cheng — tagging checklist + SI tech play (end of week). 3) Sara — CSM FAQ + webinar one-pager (EOW). 4) Jamal — ops runbook for manual credits (Thu). 5) Ben — coordinate partner marketing (ask for partner contact and confirm webinar date). I’ll sync the partner once addendum draft is in.
Ben: noted. pinging @partners-bot to book a cross-team sync next Wed at 11am PT.
partners-bot: Event created: "Marketplace floor + SI launch sync" Wed 11:00 PT. Participants: Ana, Ben, Cheng, Elliot, Sara, Jamal. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:
Ana: thanks — let’s keep slack updates in this thread. if legal or ops needs to escalate, tag me. :raised_hands:
